messages:
zoe: Compliance again: exported audit rows often show svc callers (svc:x) rather than the human. need low-risk approach to make exports forensics-friendly.

ben: Minimal change: include `actor_raw` in every row and attach a signed `actor_manifest.json` after export completes. manifest maps raw->resolved (or null) + method + resolver_version.

priya: agree. manifest should honor tenant PII flags: if tenant requests pseudonymize, manifest stores HMAC ids not raw emails. add `pii_mode` top-level meta.

zoe: ops concern: resolving distinct raw actors at scale will hit identity service. plan: stream NDJSON with raw, spawn dedupe background job that batch-looks up identities and writes manifest. do not block NDJSON delivery.

ben: add telemetry: export.distinct_actor_raw, manifest.resolve.duration, identity_api_calls, manifest.unresolved_count. also track cache hits.

priya: quota: background resolution should use internal quota and not consume customer export quota. provide admins ability to request temporary backfill exceptions for legal cases.

infra-bot: scheduled canary deploy export-manifest-worker:v1 -> staging -> tenants=10. Batches supported via POST /identity/lookup/batch.

zoe: UX: export modal shows states: exporting, manifest-pending, complete-with-manifest. show small warning when unresolved_count>0 and link to docs. allow download of NDJSON immediately.

ben: security: sign manifest (canonical JSON -> sha256 -> signature) and store signature in export metadata so downloads are tamper-evident.

priya: migration: add `generate-manifest` endpoint to run resolution for historical bundles (rate-limited, billing separate).

zoe: next steps: ben infra ticket for batch-lookup (2d), priya schema+signing spec (3d), zoe docs+UI copy (1d). export-bot: create tracking issue.

export-bot: created REDWOOD-EXPORTS-999 actor-manifest-tracking (assigned: ben).

zoe: closing thread unless objections.
